stepPayload(changeKind, ref) finds the rehearsal step matching change_kind and a target.ref or payload.id, throwing 'missing rehearsal step' when absent.
fillNodeDraft(page, payload) fills viewport create-node id/label/x/y/z from a payload's position fields.
applyQueuedIntent(page, sequence, expectedOperation) applies the next queued operation via the guided a12-review-apply-button, leaving the Operation Apply section as the receipt/audit surface.
applyQueuedIntent asserts the queue status names the expected operation, then asserts the applied receipt shows route=local_wasm_engine and professional_approval=false.
A PngImage type carries bytesPerPixel, data (Uint8Array), height, and width — the decoded screenshot model.
pngStats(buffer) decodes a PNG and returns height, opaquePixels, uniqueColors (capped at 2000), and width by scanning per-pixel.
diffPngPixels(left, right) counts pixels whose summed RGB channel delta exceeds 6 between two decoded PNG buffers.
decodePng(buffer) validates the PNG signature, parses IHDR/IDAT/IEND chunks, inflates IDAT, and reverses per-row PNG filters; it supports only bitDepth 8 and colorType 2 or 6.
filterValue(filter, left, up, upLeft) implements PNG reconstruction filters 0-4 (None, Sub, Up, Average, Paeth), throwing on unsupported filters.
paeth(left, up, upLeft) implements the PNG Paeth predictor selecting the neighbor whose estimate distance is smallest.

apply_operation_json(model_json, intent_json, claimed_model_hash_json): string validates and, when no blocking finding exists, applies the single change to a cloned model document, returning the OperationOutcome document as a JSON string.

canonical_json_string(value_json): string canonicalizes a JSON document with the engine's canonical form — RFC 8785 (JCS) since completion-plan H5 — the same function the engine uses for model hashes; the desktop frontend has no canonicalization of its own (H1 / F-5a hash seam).
canonical_sha256_hex(value_json): string returns the lowercase-hex SHA-256 of the canonical form of a JSON document (H1 / F-5a hash seam companion to canonical_json_string).
validate_operation_json(model_json, intent_json, claimed_model_hash_json): string validates a structured editor-operation intent and returns the OperationOutcome document as a JSON string.
The InitOutput interface exposes memory plus the wasm exports (apply/validate/canonical functions and wbindgen malloc/realloc/free/start) defining the engine's wasm ABI.
initSync(module) and the default __wbg_init(module_or_path) instantiate the wasm module synchronously or asynchronously, returning InitOutput.
The generated wasm-bindgen glue declares @ts-self-types pointing at the operation_applier .d.ts.
apply_operation_json glue passes model/intent/hash strings into wasm memory, calls wasm.apply_operation_json, returns the result string, and frees the deferred buffer in a finally block.
canonical_json_string glue marshals the value JSON into wasm, returns the canonical string, and throws a wasm-thrown error via takeFromExternrefTable0 when the error flag is set.
canonical_sha256_hex glue marshals the value JSON into wasm and returns the SHA-256 hex string, throwing on the wasm error flag.
validate_operation_json glue marshals model/intent/hash strings into wasm, calls wasm.validate_operation_json, and returns the outcome string.
__wbg_get_imports builds the wasm import object, wiring an Error constructor binding and __wbindgen_init_externref_table that seeds the externref table with undefined/null/true/false.
passStringToWasm0 encodes a JS string into wasm memory using the cached TextEncoder with malloc/realloc, handling the realloc-undefined fast path and multibyte growth.
decodeText decodes wasm memory bytes via a cached UTF-8 TextDecoder and resets the decoder once MAX_SAFARI_DECODE_BYTES (2146435072) is reached to avoid a Safari decode limit.
__wbg_finalize_init stores the instance/module, caches exports as wasm, resets the Uint8Array memory cache, and calls wasm.__wbindgen_start.

__wbg_load instantiates the module via WebAssembly.instantiateStreaming when given a Response, falling back to WebAssembly.instantiate with a warning when the server does not serve application/wasm MIME type.
initSync(module) returns the cached wasm if already initialized, otherwise builds imports, compiles a WebAssembly.Module if needed, and finalizes init.

__wbg_init(module_or_path) defaults module_or_path to open_pipe_stress_operation_applier_bg.wasm relative to import.meta.url, fetches URL/Request inputs, loads, and finalizes init; exported as the default.

The _bg.wasm.d.ts declares the raw wasm exports: memory plus apply_operation_json, canonical_json_string, canonical_sha256_hex, validate_operation_json, and the wbindgen malloc/realloc/free/externref/start primitives.

build-wasm-engine.mjs builds the wasm32 browser operation engine (DEC-020 / ADR-0001) by compiling core/model_operations/operation_applier with --features wasm, then binding with the pinned wasm-bindgen CLI into public/wasm-engine/.

Vite serves public/ at the site root in dev and copies it verbatim into dist, so the same root /wasm-engine/ URL works in dev, vite preview, and the packaged tauri:// asset protocol (TP-APP-R2-WASMPKG-001); the prior src/.../__generated__/ location was never emitted into dist.
Generated wasm glue is written to a temp directory and renamed into place so concurrent readers never see a half-written artifact set (DEC-025 F-4 rider); generated artifacts are not committed.
The build script pins PINNED_WASM_BINDGEN_VERSION = 0.2.123, which must match the crate's pinned wasm-bindgen dependency exactly.
The script resolves the operation_applier crate dir and expects the wasm artifact at target/wasm32-unknown-unknown/release/open_pipe_stress_operation_applier.wasm, writing glue to public/wasm-engine.
fail(lines) prints a formatted [build-wasm-engine] FAILED block and exits with code 1; every missing prerequisite fails with the exact remediation command and no silent fallback.
The build verifies cargo is on PATH, failing with rustup install guidance if absent.
The build verifies the wasm32-unknown-unknown target is installed via rustup, failing with 'rustup target add wasm32-unknown-unknown' guidance otherwise.
The build locates the wasm-bindgen CLI on PATH or in ~/.cargo/bin and fails with a cargo install command if missing.
The build asserts the wasm-bindgen CLI version equals the pinned crate version, failing because mismatched CLI/crate versions produce broken or subtly different glue.
The build compiles the engine via cargo build --target wasm32-unknown-unknown --features wasm --release and fails if the build errors or the expected artifact is missing.

The build generates web-target glue into a sibling temp dir then swaps it into place with renames (DEC-025 F-4 rider), removing stale .tmp-*/.old-* siblings and the legacy __generated__ location first.
The build runs wasm-bindgen --target web --out-dir <tmp>, renames the existing out dir to .old, renames tmp into place, and removes the old dir to swap the whole directory atomically.

The desktop lib is openpipestress_desktop_lib with crate-type staticlib, cdylib, and rlib.
The build-dependencies include tauri-build version 2.
The desktop crate depends on the core path crates: product_physics, operation_applier, library_import_document, report_renderer, rule_pack_document, rule_check_runner, and units.
